notes.title: Stylish turn-based strategy game Ex Sanguis is looking for Steam playtesters
notes.content:
Othercide is one of those games that's been on my backlog for too long. The turn-based tactics game is wonderfully stylish and seems to serve up the exact type of head-scratching combat I crave. Now, developer Lightbulb Crew is searching for playtesters to try its next project. Ex Sanguis was announced at Tacticon with a hyper-violent teaser trailer, and it looks like an evolution of Othercide in all the best ways.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Join Ex Sanguis first playtests!
notes.content: [h3]Join our playtests![/h3][p]For those who missed it, Ex Sanguis is a strategy game with dynamic & epic turn-based combat in a visually striking world. Bleed the world to life; fight the agents of perfection and stillness through strategic blood baths in this evolved roguelite tactical RPG game![/p][p][/p][p]To join the playtest, you simply need to click on "Request Access" on the game's store page. Go and join our playtest now![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643809/e7438836aec44737669cdfe84ba81c955894b9c8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Ex Sanguis exclusive images[/h3][p]Look at Ex Sanguis' first teaser trailer for TactiCon![/p][previewyoutube="HWd1XgNhKFY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We're also very pleased to share brand new visual assets of the game with you![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643809/e031a4e6a2866b4aaf820b906a7f2498623db993.png"][/img][/p][p]The game is inspired by our previous game [b]Othercide[/b], a dark fantasy turn-based tactics game in a scattered world. It is currently available on all platforms if you want to have a look![/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643809/df0fc8151584f934207955f48f333cc0b3434aa3.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643809/335893b51ed542d307f7042c30c44077bd9d5a73.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643809/20599abc8698b4699b5ebd860d42020e228cdb04.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643809/3eee519333731dae1f8063d53f6ba08722018a29.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h3]Join the community![/h3][p]Want to chat and hang out with us and other players?
